rationale: The caller value is spectralCentroid. Current “trung tâm” means a generic center; “Trọng tâm phổ” names the spectral centroid feature more specifically.

terminologyEvidence.support: The Vietnamese technical source calls the midpoint of spectral energy distribution “trọng tâm phổ” and identifies it with brightness, supporting the proposed term in the spectral-centroid caller context.
terminologyEvidence.title: Tìm kiếm âm thanh theo nội dung – Bách khoa Toàn thư Việt Nam
